name: dsh-orchestrator2
description: 自动开发调度器2.0 agent preset for the dsh web GUI: three-phase workflow (interactive design with parallel researchers and grill-me decision inventory → goal-driven single-package development with tiered hard budget caps → acceptance fix loop), six-zone project layout, two scenarios (modify existing system / tech research reserve), reliability hardening (explicit spec-version fail-closed, dispatch begin/end half-atomics, idempotent auto-mode guard, design-freeze hash), coexisting with dsh-orchestrator 1.0. The preset files are synced into ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/orchestrator2 on host startup. Mounted via cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.
